Cameron, saw Testlio launched AI Agent Testing at Money20/20 Europe and stood up the Apex Partner Program.

I built a personalized signal play for Testlio off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Cameron, quick follow-up for Testlio.

With AI Agent Testing newly live, the question is how many meetings BD actually needs to book to seed pipeline against that demand, and most teams find the gap late, then scramble the quarter. Adding reps alone rarely closes it fast enough.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Testlio needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only hire.

Cameron, last bit of proof for Testlio.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Testlio either way.
